Proposition
[Boundary smooth density under a segment condition] 1. ch7:7.9\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0167 Suppose $\partial \Omega $ has a locally finite open cover $\{ U_i\} $ and vectors $y^i$ such that $x+ty^i\in \Omega $ for every $x\in \overline\Omega \cap U_i$ and $0<t<1$. Then $C^\infty (\overline\Omega )$ is dense in $W^{k,p}(\Omega )$.
